The code correctly passes all tests, including the boundary condition fixes. However, the weekend holiday observation logic (moving Saturday holidays to Friday, Sunday to Monday) contradicts the docstring, which states holidays are "used exactly as given" and are not moved.

Please update the docstring to accurately document that holidays falling on weekends are observed on the nearest weekday (Saturday→Friday, Sunday→Monday). This resolves the contradiction between the implementation and documentation.
